detaileddescription.para: Replace an assignment statement with the result of a statement generator. Assumptions: from has assignment expr at top level of statement from is not in the test of a loop or if statement not currently traversing from

briefdescription.para: Get the topmost enclosing expression of a given expression. Needs to be moved.

detaileddescription.para: Get the statement of an expression. Somewhat smarter than the standard version of this routine, but needs to be merged.

briefdescription.para: Get the initializer containing an expression if it is within an initializer.

detaileddescription.para: Insert a new statement before or after a target statement. If allowForInit is true, the new statement can be inserted into the initializer of a for statement. Needs to be merged
Replace the expression "from" with another expression "to", wherever it appears in the AST. The expression "from" is not deleted, and may be reused elsewhere in the AST.

briefdescription.para: Convert something like "int a = foo();" into "int a; a = foo();".

detaileddescription.para: Rewrites a while or for loop so that the official test is changed to "true" and what had previously been the test is now an if-break combination (with an inverted condition) at the beginning of the loop body
For example, "while (a < 5) ++a;" becomes: "while (true) {bool temp; temp = (a < 5); if (!temp) break; ++a;}"
